versos.hebraico: הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
controles.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
controles.livre: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.

versos.hebraico: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃

controles.web: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
controles.kjv: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
controles.livre: Digam isso os resgatados pelo SENHOR, os quais ele resgatou das mão do adversário.

versos.hebraico: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃

controles.web: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
controles.kjv: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
controles.livre: E os que ele ajuntou de todas as terras, do oriente e do ocidente, do norte e do sul.

versos.hebraico: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃

controles.web: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
controles.kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
controles.livre: Os que andaram sem rumo no deserto, por caminhos solitários; os que não acharam cidade para morarem.

versos.hebraico: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃

controles.web: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
controles.kjv: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
controles.livre: Famintos e sedentos, suas almas neles desfaleciam.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃

controles.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,
controles.kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
controles.livre: Mas eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

controles.web: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
controles.kjv: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
controles.livre: E os levou ao caminho correto, para irem a uma cidade de moradia.

versos.hebraico: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
controles.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
controles.livre: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא־טֽוֹב׃

controles.web: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
controles.kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
controles.livre: Porque ele fartou a alma sedenta, e encheu de bem a alma faminta;

versos.hebraico: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃

controles.web: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
controles.kjv: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
controles.livre: Os que estavam sentados em trevas e sombra de morte, presos com aflição e ferro,

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃

controles.web: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.
controles.kjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
controles.livre: Porque se rebelaram contra os mandamentos de Deus, e rejeitaram o conselho do Altíssimo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃

controles.web: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
controles.kjv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
controles.livre: Por isso ele abateu seus corações com trabalhos cansativos; eles tropeçaram, e não houve quem os socorresse.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

controles.web: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
controles.kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
controles.livre: Porém eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.

versos.hebraico: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃

controles.web: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
controles.kjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
controles.livre: Ele os tirou das trevas e da sombra da morte, e quebrou suas correntes de prisão.

versos.hebraico: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
controles.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
controles.livre: Agradeçam ao SENHOR pela sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃

controles.web: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.
controles.kjv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
controles.livre: Porque ele quebrou as portas de bronze, e despedaçou os ferrolhos de ferro.

versos.hebraico: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֺֽנֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃

controles.web: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.
controles.kjv: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
controles.livre: Os tolos foram afligidos por causa de seu caminho de transgressões e por suas perversidades.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
controles.kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
controles.livre: A alma deles perdeu o interesse por todo tipo de comida, e chegaram até às portas da morte.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

controles.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.
controles.kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
controles.livre: Porém eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os livrou de suas aflições.

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִֽ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָֽם׃׆

controles.web: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
controles.kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
controles.livre: Ele enviou sua palavra, e os sarou; e ele os livrou de suas covas.

versos.hebraico: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃׆

controles.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
controles.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
controles.livre: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens.

versos.hebraico: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִֽיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃׆

controles.web: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with singing.
controles.kjv: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
controles.livre: E sacrifiquem sacrifícios de gratidão; e anunciai as obras dele com alegria.

versos.hebraico: יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בָּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃׆

controles.web: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
controles.kjv: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
controles.livre: Os que descem ao mar em navios, trabalhando em muitas águas,

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃׆

controles.web: These see Yahweh’s works, and his wonders in the deep.
controles.kjv: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.
controles.livre: Esses veem as obras do SENHOR, e suas maravilhas nas profundezas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃׆

controles.web: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.
controles.kjv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
controles.livre: Porque quando ele fala, ele faz levantar tormentas de vento, que levanta suas ondas.

versos.hebraico: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃

controles.web: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
controles.kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
controles.livre: Elas sobem aos céus, e descem aos abismos; a alma deles se derrete de angústia.

versos.hebraico: יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכָל־חָ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃

controles.web: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
controles.kjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
controles.livre: Eles cambaleiam e vacilam como bêbados, e toda a sabedoria deles se acaba.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃

controles.web: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
controles.kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
controles.livre: Então eles clamaram ao SENHOR em suas angústias, e ele os tirou de suas aflições.

versos.hebraico: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.
controles.kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
controles.livre: Ele fez cessar as tormentas, e as ondas se calaram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃

controles.web: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
controles.kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
controles.livre: Então se alegraram, porque houve calmaria; e ele os levou ao porto que queriam chegar .

versos.hebraico: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works for the children of men!
controles.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
controles.livre: Agradeçam ao SENHOR por sua bondade, e suas maravilhas perante os filhos dos homens;

versos.hebraico: וִֽ֭ירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃

controles.web: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
controles.kjv: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
controles.livre: E exaltem a ele na assembleia do povo, e o glorifiquem na reunião dos anciãos.

versos.hebraico: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃

controles.web: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,
controles.kjv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
controles.livre: Ele torna os rios em deserto, e as saídas de águas em terra seca.

versos.hebraico: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
controles.kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
controles.livre: A terra frutífera em salgada, pela maldade dos que nela habitam.

versos.hebraico: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם־מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.
controles.kjv: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
controles.livre: Ele torna o deserto em lagoa, e a terra seca em nascentes de águas.

versos.hebraico: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

controles.web: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
controles.kjv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
controles.livre: E faz aos famintos habitarem ali; e eles edificam uma cidade para morarem;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה׃

controles.web: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
controles.kjv: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
controles.livre: E semeiam campos, e plantam vinhas, que produzem fruto valioso.

versos.hebraico: וַיְבָרֲכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃

controles.web: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
controles.kjv: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
controles.livre: E ele os abençoa, e se multiplicam muito, e o gado dele não diminui.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃׆

controles.web: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
controles.kjv: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
controles.livre: Mas quando eles se diminuem e se abatem, por causa da opressão, mal e aflição;

versos.hebraico: שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃

controles.web: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
controles.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
controles.livre: Ele derrama desprezo sobre os governantes, e os faz andar sem rumo pelos desertos, sem terem caminho.

versos.hebraico: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
controles.kjv: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
controles.livre: Mas ao necessitado, ele levanta da opressão a um alto retiro, e faz famílias como a rebanhos.

versos.hebraico: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
controles.kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
controles.livre: Os corretos, ao verem, ficam alegres, e todo perverso se calará.

versos.hebraico: מִי־חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.
controles.livre: Quem é sábio, que preste atenção a estas coisas, e reflita nas bondades do SENHOR.
